questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 57x^2 + 212 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 53)(x^2 - 4) = 0$ with $53 \neq 4 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{53}, \pm\sqrt{4}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Integral Calculus (Reduction Formulas & Walli Integral).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 55x + 54 = 0$ and $x^2 - 6x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (6) + k = 0 \implies k = 5$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Integral Calculus (King Property in Definite Integrals).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 110x + 12 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{110} = \frac{q}{12} \implies p = 55,\; q = 6 \implies p + q = 61$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Integral Calculus (Leibniz Rule for Variable Limits).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 7$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 14x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 7$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(7) < 0 \implies 7^2 - 2(7^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 49$, so largest integer is $48$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Integral Calculus (Area Bounded by Curves).

questions.question: At what abscissa $x$ is the normal to the curve $y = x^2 - 8x$ parallel to the $y$-axis?
